comments.headline: Floor Area Ratio calculation and documentation missing
comments.summary: FAR calculation and X:1 ratio format are absent from the site plan, and FAR consistency with the Water Benchmarking Application cannot be verified because the WBA is not submitted.
comments.crossDep: Water department - verify FAR consistency between site plan data table and Water Benchmarking Application per LDC § 25-9-413.
comments.attn: Water Benchmarking Application status and FAR consistency review are pending per master comment OWB2. Confirm WBA submission status and FAR alignment across all documents.

details.text: Calculate and display FAR in the site data table: GFA (83,986 sf) ÷ Gross Site Area (94,192 sf) = 0.89:1.

runComments.comment: FAR calculation is not demonstrated on the site plan. While both GFA (83,986 sf) and Gross Site Area (94,192 sf) are documented, the Floor-to-Area Ratio calculation and its expression in X:1 format are absent from the site data table and all sheets. Calculate and display FAR as (GFA ÷ Gross Site Area) = (83,986 ÷ 94,192) = 0.89:1.

FAR calculation is not demonstrated. The work showing GFA divided by Gross Site Area is not presented anywhere on the plans. Applicant must add a calculation line to the Site Data Table showing FAR as GFA / Gross Site Area in X:1 ratio format.

details.text: FAR must appear on the cover sheet (1) and site plan (9) in X:1 ratio format (approximately 0.891:1).

runComments.comment: FAR is not expressed as a ratio in X:1 format on any site plan sheet. FAR is not shown on the cover sheet or the site plan (Sheet 9). Applicant must calculate and display FAR as a ratio (GFA ÷ Gross Site Area = approximately 0.891:1 for this project) on the site data table.

details.text: The Water Benchmarking Application (required by LDC § 25-9-413 for multifamily with 5+ units) must be submitted to verify GFA consistency. Master comment OWB2 is pending resolution.

runComments.comment: FAR values cannot be verified for consistency across multiple submissions. The Water Benchmarking Application (required by LDC § 25-9-413 for multifamily projects with 5+ units) is not included in the submittal package. Master Comment Report indicates Austin Water OWB review comment OWB2 (Current Status: Pending) requires verification that GFA and related values in the site plan match the benchmarking application, which cannot be confirmed without access to the submitted WBA.

FAR values cannot be compared across multiple locations because FAR is not shown on the cover sheet, site plan, or in publicly available excerpts from the benchmarking application. Per master comment OWB2, FAR consistency between the site data table and benchmarking application is a pending item that applicant has not yet resolved.

comments.headline: Building data table missing unit and area breakdown details
comments.summary: The site data table lacks the unit breakdown by bedroom type, floor-by-floor GFA breakdown, and total bedroom count required for parking calculations per LDC Appendix A.
comments.crossDep: Parking/traffic review may require building data confirmation to verify required parking spaces under LDC § 25-6-472(A).
comments.attn: Architectural floor plans showing individual unit bedroom configurations are not included in the primary site plan set. Confirm availability in the full architectural submission.

details.text: Unit type table must show discrete column counts: studio/efficiency, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom, and total. Current documentation combines 16 Two-Bedroom and 23 Three-Bedroom units in aggregate.

runComments.comment: Unit type breakdown table does not provide the comprehensive format required for parking calculations. Current documentation shows 16 Two Bedroom and 23 Three Bedroom units but lacks a formal zero-based table with columns for studio/efficiency, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom, and total counts. This table is required to enable quick verification of parking requirements by bedroom type per Appendix A.

Unit type breakdown table in the requested format is not provided. The project shows 16 Two Bedroom and 23 Three Bedroom units in an aggregate summary, but does not provide a standalone table with columns for studio/efficiency, 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom, and 3 bedroom unit counts. Per Site Plan Review comment SP1, applicant must add a separate table showing unit counts by bedroom type.

details.text: Buildings 1-8 (4-plex, 5-plex, 6-plex with up to 3 stories) require a floor-by-floor GFA breakdown. Current Building Data Table shows only totals per building, omitting floor-level allocations.

runComments.comment: Multi-story buildings (Buildings 1-8) lack a floor-by-floor area breakdown table. The Building Data Table shows only total GFA per building without identifying square footage allocated to each floor level. Provide a floor-by-floor GFA breakdown for each building to verify that all enclosed areas with clear height exceeding 6 feet are properly included and that parking or other excluded areas are correctly omitted from the total GFA.

details.text: Total bedroom count for the entire project (16 two-bedroom + 23 three-bedroom = 101 bedrooms) must be explicitly stated in site plan documentation.

runComments.comment: Total bedroom count for the entire development is not explicitly documented. While the count can be calculated from unit breakdown (16 two-bedroom units + 23 three-bedroom units = 101 total bedrooms), it must be directly stated in the site plan documentation for clarity. Parking requirement calculations in Appendix A reference bedroom count, making this a critical data point.

details.text: Architectural floor plans showing individual unit bedroom configurations are not provided in the primary site plan set, preventing verification of the stated 16 Two-Bedroom and 23 Three-Bedroom unit breakdown.

runComments.comment: Bedroom count per unit type cannot be verified from the available site plan documentation. While the project shows 16 Two Bedroom units and 23 Three Bedroom units at the project summary level, architectural floor plans showing individual unit bedroom configurations are not included in the primary site plan set. Unit type details must be shown in floor plans or a detailed building schedule.
